breaking_news.headline: The U.S. Senate is up for grabs. Can this Ohio Democrat win back working class votes?
breaking_news.summary: After 32 years in Congress, Ohio's Sherrod Brown lost his Senate seat in 2024 as many working class voters turned out for Trump. Now Brown is counting on union voters to send him back to Washington.

breaking_news.headline: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
breaking_news.summary: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

breaking_news.headline: Why is diesel more expensive than regular gas?
breaking_news.summary: Diesel hasn't always been more expensive than other gasoline. Then in 2004, a switch happened due to air quality standards, demand, and taxes. In this week's Indicator newsletter, we dig into diesel prices, what kind of fun people are buyin

breaking_news.headline: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
breaking_news.summary: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.

breaking_news.headline: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
breaking_news.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

breaking_news.headline: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

breaking_news.headline: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
breaking_news.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

breaking_news.headline: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

breaking_news.headline: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil election
breaking_news.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

breaking_news.headline: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
breaking_news.summary: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
breaking_news.summary: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

breaking_news.headline: Nobel Prize awarded for revealing inner workings of the brain
breaking_news.summary: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.

breaking_news.headline: Teenager's hand blown off during confrontation between France school protesters and police
breaking_news.summary: The prefect of Pas-de-Calais says the 15-year-old's life is "not in danger" after the "very serious" incident.

breaking_news.headline: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport or building, reports say
breaking_news.summary: The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports.

breaking_news.headline: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
breaking_news.summary: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.

breaking_news.headline: No10 insists UK military base RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers
breaking_news.summary: US media reported a new threat led to the bombers being removed on Sunday, following an incident near the base last week.

breaking_news.headline: How India became dangerously addicted to Chinese imports
breaking_news.summary: India’s toy shops provide an unlikely barometer by which to measure its economic relationship with China.

breaking_news.headline: Why are data centres such a big deal in Scotland?
breaking_news.summary: At least 23 huge data centres are planned in Scotland, causing significant concern for campaigners.

breaking_news.headline: UK diesel prices top £2 a litre for first time, RAC says
breaking_news.summary: The rise in global oil prices has been pushing up the pump prices of petrol and diesel in the UK.

breaking_news.headline: Trump chooses top spy boss to run new AI taskforce
breaking_news.summary: The US president said his national intelligence chief will lead the group as worries over AI grow.
